## What it is

Partie est de l'ancien `boitier_int`. Murs 30 mm. Face nord continue au-dessus du logement vis (linteau dès z = 15, collé à la dalle). Plateforme vis « bonhomme carré » : tête 11,2 × 11,6 mm, jambes à 18 mm en Y, haut à 15 mm. Goussets pleins à 45° sous la dalle. Muret d'appui identique. Puits d'aimant au nord-ouest.

## Design notes

Printed floor on the bed. Walls 30 mm except the screw platform and the west support bar (both 15 mm from z = 0). North face is a full-width wall from z = 15 to 30; the screw opening is only the housing interior below the slab. Slab top stays at 15 mm (pocket under it is 13.4 mm; coupon to check the screw). Screw gap 8 mm in X (`degagement_vis`; screw is ~5 mm, maybe 5.1). Slab 8 × 10 × 1.6 mm between the E/W walls. Visual head 11.2 × 11.6 mm including the three housing walls; E/W walls continue south to y = 77 (18 mm total, 6.4 mm of legs under the head). No south closer on the structure. Three solid 45° gussets under the slab (E, W, and the small housing-south wall), 1.6 mm run. Support bar 20 mm from the outer west face (x = 70), same 15 × 18 mm recipe. Magnet well at (60, 85).

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Don't

- Do not restore the Y nest / décrochage west of x = 50: AC starts at the DC east face (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not grow a palier/encoche south of y = 60: that tab was unused (user 2026-09-02).
- Do not cut a notch or interlocking on the west face: square wall, linking later.
- Do not restore the 10 mm gutter: the east south face runs to x = 120 at `aile_y`.
- Do not restore the seven M2 spacers or the Wago platform.
- Do not restore the rectangle AC tray (réglettes, ouverture, triangle).
- Do not drill the screw slab: it stays solid (electrical isolation, user 2026-09-03). Keep-out under the slab is 5×8 mm, top of the pocket is the gussets / slab underside.
- Do not shrink `degagement_vis` to 5 mm: the screw may be 5.1 mm.
- Do not invert the 45° under the slab into cuts: they are solid gussets that support the platform (user 2026-09-03). nurb may warn `concave_cosmetic` on the 1.6 mm south gusset; leave it.
- Do not add 1 mm 45° leftover-polish strips on the U: the requested gussets are 1.6 mm, matching the wall.
- Do not restore the 30 mm south closer of the platform: module retention comes later (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not raise the east/west legs or the muret to 30 mm: they would block the module's span (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not raise the platform top to 16.6 to close the north face: slab stays at 15 mm; close the lintel at 15 instead (user 2026-09-03, coupon for 13.4 mm screw clearance).
- Do not leave the north face open above the screw housing: from z = 15 it is full width in X (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not chamfer the Z edges of the north opening (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not put the magnet well back in the east bay: it sits at 10 mm from the north and west faces (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not reopen the whole east gutter under y_max east of x = 85: only the U remains.
